description: This file defines the interface for a STUN client within the 'stun' namespace, including classes, enums, and functions related to STUN message creation, encoding, decoding, and network discovery, specifically for the NetworkManager plugin on Raspberry Pi 4.

classes.name: attribute
classes.description: Represents a STUN attribute with type, length, and value.

classes.name: attributes::address
classes.description: Base class for address attributes, encapsulating sockaddr_storage.

classes.name: attributes::mapped_address
classes.description: Derived class for the MAPPED-ADDRESS attribute.

classes.name: attributes::source_address
classes.description: Derived class for the SOURCE-ADDRESS attribute.

classes.name: attributes::changed_address
classes.description: Derived class for the CHANGED-ADDRESS attribute.

classes.name: message
classes.description: Represents a STUN message with header and attributes, capable of encoding and attribute lookup.

classes.name: message_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating specific STUN messages, e.g., binding request.

classes.name: decoder
classes.description: Provides static methods for decoding data into STUN message components.

classes.name: encoder
classes.description: Provides static methods for encoding data into STUN message format.

classes.name: server
classes.description: Represents a server with hostname and port for network communication.

classes.name: client
classes.description: STUN client class capable of binding, discovering network type, and managing socket communication.

methods.name: create_binding_request
methods.description: Creates a new STUN binding request message.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Performs binding to a server with specified parameters and stores the result.

methods.name: discover_network_access_type
methods.description: Discovers the network access type by communicating with a specified server.

methods.name: send_binding_request
methods.description: Sends a binding request, optionally to a specific address, with a wait time.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a STUN message to a remote address and returns the response.
